title: Browser workflows
intro: Review the exact account and inputs before authorizing a browser action. An unknown outcome needs investigation before further action.
access: Sign in as an operator or owner to inspect workflows. Only an owner can approve an action.
empty: No workflow proposals on this page.
confirmation: I reviewed the account and every input below.
approved: Approval recorded. A worker will recheck authorization before acting.
cancelled: Cancellation recorded. An action already in progress may still complete.
error: The request failed. Refresh the proposal before trying again.
unknown: The destination may have accepted this action. Inspect the execution evidence; do not submit a replacement.
